messages:
frank: quick loop 1: can we add a short "debug id" visible on fallback banners so non-engineers can reference incidents when they message support?
nora: yes. must be opaque and stable (not a raw seed). make it a short base36 id like D-1k2j3.
kai: backend: we already generate sample_seed for audits. we can derive debug id = base36(hash(seed+org)) and store in breadcrumb. low cost.
frank: UX: show "Debug ID: D-1k2j3" under the inline fallback label; clicking copies to clipboard and opens small modal with "How to escalate" steps.
nora: also show small reason label "Slow primary -> fallback". keep it human.
ops-bot: incident-bot: previous trial with debug ids reduced roundtrips between PM and infra by ~25%.
kai: perf note: breadcrumb write must not include request text. only meta. retention 14d.
frank: decision: add Debug ID + human label to fallback UI; implement breadcrumb write with derived debug id; modal links to escalation doc. owners: kai -> api patch, nora -> copy & modal, frank -> rollout flag.
nora: will mock and post in #design tomorrow.
kai: will PR on Mon with schema.
frank: thanks, closing if no objections.
